analysis_script = """import re

data_text = open('prompt.txt').read()

# Parse the order rows from excel_data
lines = data_text.split('\\n')
orders = []
for line in lines:
    match = re.match(r'\\((\d+), 1\\): (ORD-\\w+)', line)
    if match:
        row_num = int(match.group(1))
        order_id = match.group(2)
        # Extract fields
        customer_m = re.search(r'\\(' + str(row_num) + r', 2\\): (.+?)\\t', line)
        date_m = re.search(r'\\(' + str(row_num) + r', 3\\): (.+?)\\t', line)
        status_m = re.search(r'\\(' + str(row_num) + r', 4\\): (.+?)\\t', line)
        items_m = re.search(r'\\(' + str(row_num) + r', 5\\): (.+?)\\t', line)
        total_m = re.search(r'\\(' + str(row_num) + r', 6\\): (.+?)\\t', line)
        orders.append({
            'order_id': order_id,
            'customer': customer_m.group(1) if customer_m else '',
            'date': date_m.group(1) if date_m else '',
            'status': status_m.group(1) if status_m else '',
            'items': items_m.group(1) if items_m else '',
            'total': float(total_m.group(1)) if total_m else 0
        })

total_orders = len(orders)
confirmed = [o for o in orders if o['status'] == 'confirmed']
cancelled = [o for o in orders if o['status'] == 'cancelled']
total_revenue = sum(o['total'] for o in confirmed)
total_all = sum(o['total'] for o in orders)
avg_order = total_revenue / len(confirmed) if confirmed else 0

# Top customers by revenue (confirmed only)
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
cust_rev = defaultdict(float)
for o in confirmed:
    cust_rev[o['customer']] += o['total']
top_customers = sorted(cust_rev.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:5]

# Product frequency
product_count = Counter()
product_rev = defaultdict(float)
for o in confirmed:
    items = [i.strip() for i in o['items'].split(',')]
    for item in items:
        product_count[item] += 1
top_products = product_count.most_common(5)

# Date distribution
date_counts = Counter(o['date'] for o in orders)

print(f"Total orders: {total_orders}")
print(f"Confirmed: {len(confirmed)}, Cancelled: {len(cancelled)}")
print(f"Total revenue (confirmed): ${total_revenue:,.0f}")
print(f"Total value (all): ${total_all:,.0f}")
print(f"Average order value (confirmed): ${avg_order:,.2f}")
print(f"\\nTop 5 customers by revenue:")
for c, r in top_customers:
    print(f"  {c}: ${r:,.0f}")
print(f"\\nTop 5 most ordered products:")
for p, cnt in top_products:
    print(f"  {p}: {cnt} orders")
print(f"\\nOrders by date:")
for d, cnt in sorted(date_counts.items()):
    print(f"  {d}: {cnt} orders")
"""
